arg.name: mode
arg.description: Mode of operation: MAP / PP / RL / MPC / (FTG). methods in brackets have not been implemented

arg.name: checkpoint
arg.description: RL mode only: path to a checkpoint saved by f1tenth_parallel_sim scripts/train.py

arg.name: direction
arg.description: RL / MPC modes only: 'ccw' / 'cw', the driving direction (the RL policy was trained for one)

arg.name: odom_topic
arg.description: RL / MPC modes only: the state estimate, in any frame. /state_estimation/odom_map is the smooth map-frame one (local odometry plus the corrected map->odom, from state_estimation's map_odom_node; the simulator does not publish it)

arg.name: sim_opp
arg.description: True to remap topics to the simulated opponent ones
